a: काथंचित्क — a. (त्की f.) Accomplished with difficulty.

v: na॰ kaTaYcit + vinayAdi॰ svArTe Wak tAntatvAt Wasya kaH । kaTaYcidityarTe ।
m: काथञ्चित्क mf(ई)n. (fr. कथंचिद्), accomplished with difficulty g. विनयादि.
काथक m. a son or descendant of Kathaka, Pravar.
काथक्यायनी f. of Kāthakya g. लोहितादि.

v: pu॰ strI kaTakasya gotrApatyaM gargA॰ yaY । kaTakarzergotrApatye yUni tu yaYantatvAt Pak । kATakyAyana tadIya yuvagotrApatye । striyAM lohitakatAntAdi॰ zPaH zittvAt NIz । kATakyAyanI tadgotrApatyastriyAm ।
tri॰ kaTAyAM sADu kayAdi॰ Wak । kaTAracanAsamarTe
m: काथिक mf(ई)n. (fr. 1. कथा), belonging to a tale, told in a tale, W.
काथिक m. a narrator of stories, W.
a: काथिकः — [कथायां साधुः, कथा-ठक्] A narrator of stories; also a writer of stories.
